international.title: Four UK men convicted of sexual assault and rape of woman at invitation of husband
international.summary: Former Tory councillor advertised ex-wife on swinging websites and drugged and bound her for sex Four men have been convicted of sexually assaulting and raping a woman at the invitation of her husband who had drugged and bound her. Philip Young, 50, advertised his then wife, Joanne Young, on dating and swinging websites, presenting it as a “kink” for both of them, Winchester crown court heard. In fact, he had been sedating her, plunging her into an “inanimate state” where anything could be done to her by whoever answered the adverts, jurors were told. Continue reading...
